label: final-bundle-tuning-v2
method: Paired same-position comparison against real Chess.com rapid moves within the tier interval. 4 fixed bot seeds, shipped allowance and worker allocation. Stockfish 19 Lite depth10, hash cleared. Anchor is a forced root search of the unrestricted preferred move, compared with identical forced root searches of human/bot moves; preferred-root loss is asserted zero. Loss capped at1000cp including mate transitions. Contributor accounts split before tuning. Mean loss ratio measures calibration distance, not competitive Elo. No skipped positions or failures.
